page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number 155 at top right. Main text in two parallel verse columns at top (left column: O patriarcha pauperum...; right column: Quos cancellatis manibus...), then continuing full-width text below. No marginal notes beyond the page text.

main_text.p: Hic Franciscus pauper & modicus, coelum dives ingreditur, hymnis caelestibus honoratur.
main_text.head: DE S. BONAVENTURA, SERAPHICO, Ordinis Franciscanorum.
main_text.p: O praesul dignissime Bonaventura doctor inclyte, audi servulos tuos, ut possideat gaudia beatorum perenniter in patria. Tecu. Hall.
main_text.head: DE EREMITIS.
DE S. GALLO. 16. Octobris.
main_text.p: Quaesumus mundi fator & redemptor, ut sacris ejus precibus tueri hanc velis plebem, tribuens, quod optat corde benigno.
main_text.head: DE ELEEMOSYNARIIS.
main_text.p: Collecta: Deus, cujus misericordiae non est numerus, suscipe propitius preces humilitatis nostrae, & animabus, quae nobis in oratione commendatae sunt, & quorum utimur eleemosynis vel usi sumus, quibus tui nominis dedisti confessionem, cunctorum remissionem tribue peccatorum.

page.notes: The two verse columns at the top are parallel; the first is left, the second right. Some words in the scan are faint or damaged (e.g. "Tecu. Hall." and "Se-" at the foot), and the reading of several lines of the Gallo and Eleemosynariis passages is uncertain.
